newsitem.title: USA: Russia plans May, autumn Eurobonds - deputy minister.
newsitem.headline: Russia plans May, autumn Eurobonds - deputy minister.

text.p: Russia plans to issue its next Eurobond in May, followed by one in the autumn, Deputy Finance Minister Oleg Vyugin said on Tuesday.

Vyugin, responsible for banks, securities markets and relations with the International Monetary Fund, told Reuters the May bond would be issued in dollars, but no decision had been made on the currency for the second bond.
"The plan of action is to place a Eurobond in May and one in the Autumn," Vyugin said. He gave no volumes for either issue.

Russia has already issued two eurobonds, one in dollars and one in marks. Officials have announced plans for two more issues this year, the first of them in dollars. Some officials hope a ruble Eurobond can be issued next year.
